## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (99%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Invasive risk is 0%, models agree, and tubule and validated stroma concepts push against malignancy [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Normal 99%, Benign 1%, InSitu 0%, Invasive 0% | Strong Normal call, 0% invasive |
| Conformal set | {Normal} at 90% target (90% test coverage) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 99% reliability, 10th percentile OOD (12/12 regions) [F6] | Typical image, passed quality check |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Yes (same top class) | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal (93%–95% similarity); Benign contrast 90% [F5] | Matches Normal reference neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 0, 2, 9) · ↓ invasive · Strongest anti-invasive score (-1.28), but unreliable (0/20 AI spot check) [F2] · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 4, 5, 6) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.64) pushing away from invasive carcinoma [F3] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 7, 8, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.43) supporting benign stromal background [F4] · Validated
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Below-average score (-0.39) pushing away from stromal invasion · Validated
- **HoVer-Net nuclei segmentation** (regions 3, 8, 10) · context · 91 neoplastic nuclei segmented in region 10 (670/mm², 71st percentile) · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Validated as faithful (deleting top-3 risk regions drops invasive probability by 0.0114 vs random, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0), and top driver "Normal lobules" is unreliable (0/20 spot check).

## Could be wrong if
- Region 10 harbors focal atypia or neoplasia, given 91 HoVer-Net neoplastic nuclei and a 0.12 duct-confined score.
- A benign lesion mimics normal lobules, like Benign contrast case BACH_0029 (90% similarity) differing in unreliable normal lobules.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 10**: Inspect the 91 segmented neoplastic nuclei, 16 inflammatory cells, and highest lymphocyte/duct-confined scores for focal atypia.
2. **Regions 0, 2, 9**: Verify normal two-layered lobules directly, as the model's top concept here is unreliable (0/20 spot check).
3. **Regions 4, 5, 6, 8**: Confirm benign tubules (4, 5, 6) and rule out stromal invasion in region 8 (score 0.36).
